subject: maths
prompt_en: From that table (mango 5, apple 2, banana 2, guava 1), how many more children chose mango than apple?
prompt_hi: Usi table se (mango 5, apple 2, banana 2, guava 1), apple se kitne zyada bachchon ne mango chuna?

subject: maths
prompt_en: Why is a frequency table easier than the list of 10 fruits for answering 'Which fruit is the favourite?'
prompt_hi: 'Favourite fruit kaunsa hai?' iska jawab dene ke liye 10 fruits ki list se frequency table aasaan kyon hai?
answer: The table has already grouped and counted each fruit, so you just pick the biggest number instead of re-counting the list

subject: maths
prompt_en: Before counting, predict: four tally bundles and two single lines make what number?
prompt_hi: Ginne se pehle guess karo: chaar tally bundles aur do akeli lines kaunsa number banate hain?

subject: maths
prompt_en: Neha says this tally shows 7: one full bundle (four upright lines with a fifth line drawn across them), plus three more lines. Check her.
prompt_hi: Neha kehti hai yeh tally 7 dikhati hai: ek poora bundle (chaar khadi lines aur unke upar paanchvi line aar-paar), aur 3 aur lines. Check karo.
answer: It shows 8; the line across counts as the fifth mark

subject: maths
prompt_en: 30 children were surveyed. The table says cricket 12, football 9, kabaddi 7, badminton 4. Is there a problem?
prompt_hi: 30 bachchon ka survey hua. Table kehti hai cricket 12, football 9, kabaddi 7, badminton 4. Koi problem hai?
answer: Yes: the frequencies add to 32, not 30, so something was counted wrongly

subject: maths
prompt_en: How children in a colony get to school: walk 14, bus 9, auto-rickshaw 6, cycle 11. How many children altogether, and which way is least used?
prompt_hi: Ek colony ke bachche school kaise jaate hain: paidal 14, bus 9, auto-rickshaw 6, cycle 11. Kul kitne bachche hain, aur sabse kam kaunsa tareeka?
answer: 40 children; auto-rickshaw is least used

subject: maths
prompt_en: Your class wants to choose a picnic place. Plan the data: what question will you ask, what options, and how will you record the answers?
prompt_hi: Tumhari class picnic ki jagah chunna chahti hai. Data ka plan banao: kya sawaal poochoge, kaun se options, aur answers kaise record karoge?
answer: Ask one clear question with fixed options (e.g. zoo, lake, fort), record one tally per child, count frequencies, check the total equals class size, and pick the highest

subject: maths
prompt_en: Turn the frequency 'red: 7' into tally marks. Describe them.
prompt_hi: Frequency 'red: 7' ko tally marks mein badlo. Batao kaise dikhenge.
answer: One bundle of five (four lines crossed by a fifth) and two more lines

subject: maths
prompt_en: Teach a friend how to organise 20 answers about favourite colours.
prompt_hi: Dost ko sikhao favourite colours ke 20 answers ko kaise organise karein.
answer: List the colours as categories, put one tally mark per answer in bundles of five, count each colour's frequency, and check the total is 20

subject: maths
prompt_en: Quick! How do you show 5 in tally marks?
prompt_hi: Jaldi! Tally marks mein 5 kaise dikhate hain?
answer: Four upright lines with one line across them

subject: maths
prompt_en: Key: 1 tree picture = 10 trees. Class 6B has 3 and a half pictures. How many trees?
prompt_hi: Key: 1 picture = 10 ped. Class 6B ki saadhe teen pictures hain. Kitne ped?

subject: maths
prompt_en: Key: 1 picture = 5 rotis. Raju's row has 6 pictures and Sita's has 4. Before multiplying, predict: did Raju make 2 more rotis or 10 more?
prompt_hi: Key: 1 picture = 5 rotiyan. Raju ki row mein 6 pictures, Sita ki mein 4. Guna karne se pehle guess karo: Raju ne 2 zyada rotiyan banayi ya 10 zyada?
answer: 10 more (2 extra pictures × 5)

subject: maths
prompt_en: Key: 1 bus = 20 students. Arun read 2 and a half bus pictures as 60 students. Check him.
prompt_hi: Key: 1 bus = 20 students. Arun ne dhaai bus pictures ko 60 students padha. Check karo.
answer: Wrong: half a bus is 10 students, so 20 + 20 + 10 = 50

subject: maths
prompt_en: Why does a pictograph need a key?
prompt_hi: Pictograph ko key ki zaroorat kyon hoti hai?
answer: One picture can stand for many items; without the key you cannot know how many each picture means

subject: maths
prompt_en: You need to show 25, 40, 15 and 30 trees. Which key is better: 1 picture = 5 trees, or 1 picture = 3 trees?
prompt_hi: Tumhe 25, 40, 15 aur 30 ped dikhane hain. Kaunsa key behtar hai: 1 picture = 5 ped, ya 1 picture = 3 ped?
answer: 1 picture = 5 trees: every value is a multiple of 5 (5, 8, 3, 6 pictures), but 3 does not divide them

subject: maths
prompt_en: Show 25 trees with key 1 picture = 5 and with key 1 picture = 10. How many pictures in each, and what is the trade-off?
prompt_hi: 25 ped ko key 1 picture = 5 aur key 1 picture = 10 se dikhao. Dono mein kitni pictures, aur kya fark padta hai?
answer: Key 5: 5 pictures; key 10: 2½ pictures. Key 10 is shorter but needs a half picture

subject: maths
prompt_en: Key: 1 cricket-ball picture = 8 runs. A batter's row has 7 balls. How many runs?
prompt_hi: Key: 1 cricket ball ki picture = 8 runs. Ek batter ki row mein 7 balls hain. Kitne runs?

subject: maths
prompt_en: Van Mahotsav: key 1 picture = 12 trees. Class 6A has 5 pictures and 6B has 3½. How many more trees did 6A plant?
prompt_hi: Van Mahotsav: key 1 picture = 12 ped. Class 6A ki 5 pictures aur 6B ki saadhe teen. 6A ne kitne zyada ped lagaye?

subject: maths
prompt_en: Turn 18 laddoos into a pictograph row with key 1 picture = 4 laddoos. How many pictures?
prompt_hi: 18 laddoos ko pictograph row mein badlo, key 1 picture = 4 laddoo. Kitni pictures?
answer: 4½ pictures

subject: maths
prompt_en: Teach a friend how to read any pictograph.
prompt_hi: Dost ko sikhao koi bhi pictograph kaise padhte hain.
answer: First read the key; count the pictures in the row, counting half pictures as half; multiply by the key value

subject: maths
prompt_en: Quick! Key: 1 star = 6 children. 3 stars means how many children?
prompt_hi: Jaldi! Key: 1 star = 6 bachche. 3 stars matlab kitne bachche?

subject: maths
prompt_en: In one pictograph 1 picture = 2 kites; in another 1 picture = 10 kites. Both rows have 5 pictures. Is it the same number of kites?
prompt_hi: Ek pictograph mein 1 picture = 2 patang; doosre mein 1 picture = 10 patang. Dono rows mein 5 pictures hain. Kya patang barabar hain?
answer: No: 10 kites in the first and 50 in the second

subject: maths
prompt_en: A bar ends halfway between the 40 and 50 marks. What value does it show?
prompt_hi: Ek bar 40 aur 50 ke beech bilkul aadhe pe khatam hota hai. Woh kitna value dikhata hai?

subject: maths
prompt_en: Runs are 35, 80, 55 and 20. The graph can be 10 units tall. Which scale fits: 1 unit = 5 runs or 1 unit = 10 runs?
prompt_hi: Runs hain 35, 80, 55 aur 20. Graph 10 units tak lamba ho sakta hai. Kaunsa scale fit hoga: 1 unit = 5 runs ya 1 unit = 10 runs?
answer: 1 unit = 10 runs: 80 needs 8 units, but with 5 runs per unit it needs 16

subject: maths
prompt_en: An axis starts at 90. Team A's bar reaches 100, Team B's reaches 95, and A's bar looks twice as tall. Predict: did A really score twice as many?
prompt_hi: Axis 90 se shuru hota hai. Team A ka bar 100 tak, Team B ka 95 tak, aur A ka bar dugna lamba dikhta hai. Guess karo: kya A ne sach mein dugne score kiye?
answer: No, 100 is only 5 more than 95

subject: maths
prompt_en: Why should the value axis of a bar graph start at 0?
prompt_hi: Bar graph ka value axis 0 se kyon shuru hona chahiye?
answer: So bar heights are in proportion to the values; otherwise small differences look much bigger than they are

subject: maths
prompt_en: Mona drew the bar for mango extra wide because mango is the favourite. Is that OK?
prompt_hi: Mona ne mango ka bar extra chauda banaya kyunki mango favourite hai. Kya yeh theek hai?
answer: No: all bars must be the same width; only height shows the value, and a wide bar looks unfairly big

subject: maths
prompt_en: Scale: 1 square = 20 students. The bus bar is 4 squares tall. Kabir says 4 students take the bus. Fix it.
prompt_hi: Scale: 1 square = 20 students. Bus wala bar 4 squares ka hai. Kabir kehta hai 4 students bus se jaate hain. Theek karo.
answer: 80 students (4 × 20)

subject: maths
prompt_en: Scale 1 unit = 5 runs. Batter A's bar is 9 units and Batter B's is 13 units. How many more runs did B score?
prompt_hi: Scale 1 unit = 5 runs. Batter A ka bar 9 units, Batter B ka 13 units. B ne kitne zyada runs banaye?

subject: maths
prompt_en: Cups of chai sold: Monday 30, Tuesday 45, Wednesday 20. With scale 1 unit = 5 cups, how tall is each bar?
prompt_hi: Bechi gayi chai ki cups: Monday 30, Tuesday 45, Wednesday 20. Scale 1 unit = 5 cups ho toh har bar kitna lamba hoga?
answer: 6, 9 and 4 units

subject: maths
prompt_en: Mobile data used: January 2 GB, February 3 GB, March 6 GB, drawn with 1 unit = 1 GB. Which month's bar is twice February's, and how much did use rise from January to March?
prompt_hi: Mobile data use: January 2 GB, February 3 GB, March 6 GB, scale 1 unit = 1 GB. Kis mahine ka bar February ka dugna hai, aur January se March tak use kitna badha?
answer: March is twice February (6 = 2 × 3); use rose by 4 GB

subject: maths
prompt_en: When is a pictograph better, and when is a bar graph better?
prompt_hi: Pictograph kab behtar hai, aur bar graph kab?
answer: A pictograph suits small, friendly numbers and a quick picture; a bar graph suits large or exact values read against a scale

subject: maths
prompt_en: Teach a friend the rules for drawing a fair bar graph.
prompt_hi: Dost ko ek fair bar graph banane ke rules sikhao.
answer: Title and labels; a scale starting at 0 that fits the biggest value; all bars the same width with equal gaps; heights from the scale

subject: maths
prompt_en: Quick! In a bar graph, what shows the value: the bar's width or its height?
prompt_hi: Jaldi! Bar graph mein value kya dikhata hai: bar ki chaudai ya lambai?
answer: Its height (length)

subject: maths
prompt_en: Say the first five multiples of 7.
prompt_hi: 7 ke pehle paanch multiples batao.

subject: maths
prompt_en: Find the common factors of 18 and 24.
prompt_hi: 18 aur 24 ke common factors nikalo.

subject: maths
prompt_en: Idli-vada game: say 'idli' on multiples of 3, 'vada' on multiples of 5, and 'idli-vada' on both. What do you say at 30, at 25 and at 27?
prompt_hi: Idli-vada game: 3 ke multiples pe 'idli', 5 ke multiples pe 'vada', dono pe 'idli-vada'. 30, 25 aur 27 pe kya bologe?
answer: 30: idli-vada; 25: vada; 27: idli

subject: maths
prompt_en: If the game used multiples of 4 and 6, guess first: is the first 'idli-vada' at 24?
prompt_hi: Agar game 4 aur 6 ke multiples se khela jaaye, pehle guess karo: kya pehla 'idli-vada' 24 pe aayega?
answer: No, at 12

subject: maths
prompt_en: Rahul says, 'The factors of 6 are 6, 12, 18, 24.' What did he mix up?
prompt_hi: Rahul kehta hai, '6 ke factors 6, 12, 18, 24 hain.' Usne kya gadbad ki?
answer: Those are multiples of 6; the factors are 1, 2, 3, 6

subject: maths
prompt_en: Why does 15 have only a few factors but endless multiples?
prompt_hi: 15 ke factors thode se kyon hain, par multiples ka koi ant kyon nahi?
answer: Factors cannot be bigger than 15, so the list stops; multiples keep growing (15, 30, 45 …) forever
